Plot the local biplot for a bl_local_result

plot.bl_local_result.Rd

Renders the rotated biplot for the best eigenvector pair found by bl_find_local_cf using the same biplotEZ pipeline as plot_biplotEZ. The biplotEZ object is patched with the rotated loading matrix (Vr_rot) and rotated training coordinates (Z_train_rot) so that axes, grid, points, and contours are all drawn in the locally-rotated Z-space. Training points are coloured by confusion type (TP = red, TN = blue, FP = purple, FN = orange). The target observation is shown as a filled circle coloured by the confusion scheme when its true class is known from bl_result$test_data, or red/blue by predicted class for external points. The nearest boundary point is shown as a cross with an arrow.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'bl_local_result'
plot(
  x,
  no_grid = FALSE,
  plot_points = FALSE,
  no_contour = FALSE,
  cex_z = 0.5,
  label_dir = "Paral",
  label_cex = 1,
  tick_label_cex = 0.6,
  ticks_v = 1L,
  ticks_var = 0L,
  ticks_n = 5L,
  which = NULL,
  X_names = NULL,
  label_offset_var = 0L,
  label_offset_dist = 1.5,
  rotate_deg = 0,
  show_arrows = TRUE,
  arrow_col = "grey30",
  contour_col = "black",
  contour_lwd = 1.5,
  contour_lty = 1L,
  print_summary = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A "bl_local_result" object.

no_grid

Logical; if TRUE the prediction grid is hidden. Default FALSE.

plot_points

Logical; if FALSE (default) training points are hidden (show only the target and counterfactual). Set to TRUE to also show training data. To overlay test or holdout data instead, use plot_biplotEZ with its points argument.

no_contour

Logical; if TRUE boundary contour lines are hidden. Default FALSE.

cex_z

Numeric; size of training data points. Default 0.5.

label_dir

Character; biplotEZ axis label direction. "Paral" (default) follows the plot border – left/right borders are vertical, top/bottom are horizontal. "Hor" forces horizontal. "Orthog" draws labels perpendicular to the axis.

label_cex

Numeric; variable name (axis label) size. Default 1.

tick_label_cex

Numeric; axis tick label size. Default 0.6.

ticks_v

Integer; number of ticks per variable axis. Default 1L.

ticks_var

Integer, integer vector, character, or character vector; variable(s) whose tick-mark count should override ticks_v. Supply variable names (e.g. "Sepal.Length") or integer indices (e.g. c(1L, 3L)). 0 (default) means no override – every axis uses ticks_v.

ticks_n

Integer or integer vector; tick-mark count(s) for the variable(s) named in ticks_var. A single value applies to all listed variables; a vector must match the length of ticks_var. Default 5L.

which

Integer vector; indices of variables to draw axes for. Defaults to all variables.

X_names

Character vector; custom variable names for axis labels. Defaults to bl_result$var_names.

label_offset_var

Integer, integer vector, character, or character vector; variable(s) whose axis labels should be shifted outward. Supply variable names or integer indices. 0 (default) means no offset.

label_offset_dist

Numeric or numeric vector; outward offset distance(s) in margin lines. Useful range 1–3. Default 1.5.

rotate_deg

Numeric; additional clockwise rotation in degrees applied on top of the SVD-derived local rotation. Default 0.

show_arrows

Logical; if TRUE (default) an arrow is drawn from the target to its counterfactual.

arrow_col

Character; colour for the CF cross and arrow. Default "grey30".

contour_col

Character; colour for contour lines. Default "black".

contour_lwd

Numeric; line width for contour lines. Default 1.5.

contour_lty

Integer; line type for contour lines. Default 1L.

print_summary

Logical; print a local CF summary to the console. Default TRUE. Set to FALSE when called from plot.bl_sparse_result.

...

Additional arguments (currently ignored).
